stories.title: Salt Lake County 'Giving Tree' brings hope to older adults this holiday season
stories.summary: For many older adults, the holiday season can be especially difficult. But a Salt Lake County tradition is helping bring support to seniors this Christmas season.

stories.title: Mamdani sets plan to close NYC's notorious Rikers Island jail
stories.summary: New York City's Rikers Island jail would close by 2032 under a plan announced Friday by Mayor Zohran Mamdani, whose strategy hinges on reducing the number of people behind bars.

stories.title: 'These kids deserve better': Mother speaks out after son's unlawful school seclusions
stories.summary: Despite a statewide ban on seclusion in Kindergarten, Lori says it happened to her son twice. New data suggests the practice is on the rise, prompting calls to end it altogether.

stories.title: Man escapes from ICE custody in Salt Lake City, DHS says
stories.summary: A man escaped from custody at the ICE Salt Lake City Processing Center on Thursday, according to ICE Salt Lake City, an agency under the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

stories.title: Annual Make-A-Wish fundraiser has this Utah high school principal getting waxed and more
stories.summary: This was "Wish Week" at Salem Hills High School in Utah County, where all of the events and all of the focus were on raising money for one child and the Make-A-Wish Foundation.

stories.title: Mike Lee unveils plan to formally dismantle Department of Education
stories.summary: Sen. Mike Lee is pushing forward with a plan to formally abolish the Department of Education and reallocate its responsibilities to other areas of the federal government.

stories.title: Lori Daybell's mother, siblings take 'Deceived' podcast on a deep dive into family's past
stories.summary: In the latest episode of "Deceived: The Daybell Story," Lori Daybell's mother and siblings tell podcast host Nate Eaton what they believe contributed to their deviant behavior.

stories.title: The world is experiencing 'GTA VI' together — players and spectators alike
stories.summary: Millions of people around the world are playing "Grand Theft Auto VI." Millions more are watching other people play it.

stories.title: Man arrested after making gun-like gesture, threatening to shoot people at UVU, police say
stories.summary: Police say a man threatened to shoot people at Utah Valley University's campus, triggering an alert sent to students.

stories.title: Weather service's final winter outlook is a coin flip for Utah, but there are positive signs
stories.summary: What the National Weather Service winter outlook shows for other states could signal hope for snow recreation enthusiasts and water managers across the Beehive State.

stories.title: 4 ways you can 'love your kids so much that their grandkids feel it'
stories.summary: Eli Harwood shares four ways parents can help build generational love.
